notes.title: Steam Keys for previous purchasers.
notes.content:
You can redeem the Steam Keys if you have bought the game before. 
*This only applied for people who bought the Win/Mac, not the mobile ones. 

[h1]For Bundles' Purchasers[/h1]
Please contact Indie Royale or Groupees since I've sent the keys to both parties. 

[h1]For People Who Bought The Hardcopies or Bought Through Official Site[/h1]
Please fill in the form on the link below and I'll send you the keys later. 
[url=http://www.roseverte.net/steam.html]CLICK HERE[/url]

[h1]For People Who Bought Through Desura[/h1]
For people who bought on Desura directly, not from any bundles, please PM me on Desura.

I don't accept any questions or claims about the bundle provider's services. I will only help you to ask them if they're quite late in uploading the keys.

Thank you.
